## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 03.09.2026 - 03.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Jose Maria Araque_, 03.09.2026, 1/5: "The app was good before, I paid for the single-time ad free version. Despite that they now blocked certain features that were free before behind a monthly paywall. Reply: yes, some exercises I was using in the past for free are now behind the subscription. I changed my phone and this features cant be transfert to the new one."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 20.07.2026 - 12.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Evan Metcalfe_, 12.08.2026, 1/5: "This app was awesome, so much so that you didn't even mind the couple of ads it had because that meant the app was free. Buy some update must have happened because now I get the same ad for some other fitness app and even though there is a close button, no matter how many times I press it or wait or close and reopen the app, the ad does not close so this app is now completely unusable for me. I cannot even provide feedback in app as the ads start immediately on opening the app"
            2. _Joshua johnston_, 20.07.2026, 4/5: "the ads generated in the app will freeze the app itself. other than that the app is phenomenal. I do wish there were a few more unlocked exercises, but as a free app there's nothing missing. logging and generating exercise plans are great and the fact that I can regenerate a single exercise or all of them. 4.2/5"
<!--/ir-theme-->
